reviews.text: Valerie is the best! We are very thankful for all the work she is doing with our dog. She helped us so much to understand our dog’s behavior and how to train him. Her prices are reasonable and she is super professional. Strongly recommend to any dog owner. Our family (including our pooch) love her!

Valerie was instrumental in showing our little fella the fundamentals in being a good boy. He is a work in progress and Valerie gave us the tools to help him become a better-integrated member of our pack. We loved her patience with him and with us as well! She uses positive reinforcement, which is exactly what Oliver responds to. She also helped our 12-year old daughter have more confidence in being more assertive with him, which helped their dynamic and she’s no longer his chew toy. We highly recommend Valerie!

We had a fantastic experience with Valerie!! She understood our new puppy completely and taught us some very valuable skills to use with him!! I would certainly recommend her services for SW Houston area folks!!
We absolutely enjoyed working with Valerie. She is amazing! She got my doggie doing tricks in minutes. I appreciate very much her support and dedication.
It was such a pleasure to work with Valerie, and her training with our furbaby Gracie, (Cavapoo) was amazing! Thank you SO MUCH Valerie!!

Valerie helped us train our new rescue, Posey, at around 1.5 years old. Valerie was informative and friendly both during the consultation and the actual trainings. We never felt rushed during our sessions. She was easy to schedule with, and she always tailored the sessions to our goals with Posey. Her instructions were easy to follow, which made practicing during the week easy. We've been so impressed with the results. Posey is no longer barking at other dogs on walks and is working to master all the basic commands. We appreciated that it was a system based on reward and positive reinforcement. We can't recommend Smarty Paws Dog Training enough!

She was amazing! From the very beginning, she was patient, knowledgeable, and truly cared about helping my dog succeed. She took the time to explain everything clearly and gave us the tools and confidence to continue training at home. I saw a huge improvement in my dog’s behavior, listening skills, and overall confidence. Her positive approach made the experience enjoyable for my family and our dog. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a professional, caring, and effective dog trainer! 🐾💕
Valerie was absolutely amazing. I'm so glad that we chose this company to train our Pup.

Valerie was great with my puppy! She was super knowledgeable and explained all the commands to us. Our pup learned so quickly too! Our puppy loves her; she was so sweet to my girl. We plan on using her again for future trainings. 10/10 recommend!

My mini schnauzer mix loves Valerie and so do I. She’s a great listener and always had practical advice whenever I shared a problem I was having my puppy. She helped me with his leash training and learning commands (sit, down, paw, touch, leave it). I highly recommend her and her at-home program for puppies and hope I can continue training Robin with her help even now that he has graduated from puppy preschool! I say “with her” because this was truly as beneficial for me as it was for my puppy.

This was such an amazing program not only for our puppy but us as well. Valerie took the time to listen to concerns we had worked Sadie’s program around that. Most importantly she taught us how to train and interact with our puppy. For what you get, the price for puppy preschool is a steal. I would 1000% recommend Smarty Paws!!!
We thoroughly enjoyed working with Valerie to train our Sylvie. She uses simple treat-related exercises.  And it worked beautifully for her.  Thank you Valerie😊

Chloe is a 4 months old miniature dachshund and a full of energy dog. Valerie was great with her, with simple commands we were able to change some bad behaviors and we started crate training. Chloe and us had fun while learning from Valerie. We really recommend Smarty Paws Dog Training as it improved our relationship with our pet.

We’ve had such a wonderful experience with Smarty Paws! From the very first session, it was clear that she brings a wealth of experience and knowledge to her training. Every lesson was well-paced and thoughtfully tailored to our dog’s needs and our family’s lifestyle.

She took the time to explain not just what to do, but *why*—which made it so much easier for us to reinforce positive habits at home. We’ve already seen  growth in our dog’s behavior, confidence, and focus. Walks are calmer, commands are followed more consistently, and our whole family feels more connected to our pup.

We highly recommend Smarty Paws  for anyone looking for a patient, skilled, and genuinely caring trainer!
Thank you so much for helping Odie with the foundational skills needed to be a happy doggie! The one to one training made a huge difference and I’m grateful! I would recommend Valerie anytime!
Valerie is a very professional trainer. She helped us train our new Irish Wolfhound puppy. It was a pleasure working with her. Definitely recommended.

I learned a lot about training my puppy and positive reinforcement.  I wanted to work with potty training a little more, but I realize it is different than a command and takes time.  We did get some good pointers and my puppy ans me learned a lot of useful things.

Valerie did an amazing job with our 6 month old golden. She was able to address all of our needs and also educate us while training our pup. We are extremely happy with our results and appreciate her hard work!

Valerie with Smarty Paws was the perfect trainer for our little Cavalier (Gracie). She taught us so many different commands we can use to help make day to day life with our fur baby much flow much better. Valerie has the perfect demeanor for the job! We will be calling her back when our other puppy is ready for training, and we highly recommend her.

I enjoyed watching our little Bella grow and learn during her basic training right at home! It was awesome to see her progress at her own pace. Now, she sits and stays on her mat when we go out in public and listens to all the basic commands! I absolutely recommend Smarty Paws Dog Training to every puppy owner—it's been a fantastic experience!

Our experience with Valerie was amazing! She was quick in our initial inquiry, worked with my busy work schedule, and helped me learn how to teach my puppy important skills to keep him safe and learn obedience. She was always exceptionally kind, came to my home for all the lessons, modeled the lessons, guided me through practice, then let me go with a plan to work through during the week until our next session. In 4 short weeks our pup learned to sit, walk a leash, focus his attention through distractions, lay on his bed and stay, leave things alone on the floor or drop it if it's in his mouth, stay at an open door, and even "play dead" - the one trick my children wanted him to learn. If you are looking to help your pup be the best he can be, look no further than Smarty Paws Dog Training!
unprofessional with an attitude and terrible prices - risk it for the biscuit at your own expense 😂 …
Valerie got our puppy to calm down, listen to commands and turn in to the best family member for our family. Highly recommend.

We had a great experience with our trainer and I feel that Zoe, my 16 month old  Havapoo, learned a lot.  I will continue to practice what we learned and would like to do more work with Valerie as Zoe gets older.

Valerie has been a true lifesaver for us! We rescued a schnauzer puppy, Luka, that had some issues. The vet diagnosed him with fear aggression and we were devastated! So I called Smarty Paws and Valerie came to the rescue! After her first …
A really great experience for my smart, shy & stubborn (at times) pup! I would highly recommend Valerie!
Loved working with Valerie with our 10 month old rescue. She was patient and knowledgeable. Charlie loved her!

Valerie is Amazing.  We have corrected the behaviors that needed correcting.  So nice to be able to walk my dog on a leash without the pulling.  The truth is, dogs are really smart.  Owners are the ones who really need to be trained.  I am guilty as charged, but we are on a new path..
Valerie was always on time. She had a plan each visit which was based on our goals. Leo loved her! We learned a lot🐾 …
Valerie was great!
